system.description: Once per long rest, when you enter a dangerous fight, set your Kill Chain Die to d10. Until the scene ends or you take Severe damage, your Kill Chain Die does not reset when you fail an attack roll. While this feature is active, you can’t willingly move away from all adversaries unless an ally is in immediate danger.
